summary: Credicorp Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting a series of planned management changes. The board accepted resignations of Head of Microfinance Javier Ichazo, CFO Alejandro Pérez-Reyes Zarak, and Chief Corporate Audit Officer Jose Esposito, with appointments of successors Alejandro Pérez-Reyes Zarak (to Head of Microfinance), Ignacio Belaunde Zuzunaga (CFO), and Rosa Cigüeñas Espinel (Chief Corporate Audit Officer). Transitions are staggered, effective October 1, 2026 and May 1, 2027. No financial terms or advisor involvement. The changes are orderly successions, not abrupt departures. Watch for any future strategic shifts under new leadership.
